The plate spans about 355 px across. If it is a 26 cm dinner plate, that is roughly 13.6 px/cm.

The sausage is about 140 px long, which is roughly 10 cm. Its width is about 60 px, which is roughly 4.5 cm. Its thickness is probably around 3.5 cm.

Treating it as a cylinder with a 3.5 cm diameter and 10 cm length gives a volume of about 96 cm³. That points to roughly 90 g, though a typical pork sausage of this size would more likely weigh 70-90 g. I'll take 80 g.

Cooked pork sausage runs about 300 kcal per 100 g, so 80 g is about 240 kcal.

{"kcal": 240, "mass_g": 80}
